name: holler
description: Durable local communication between Claude Code and Codex agents.

actor.title: Holler actor
actor.description: Stable actor name used to address this Claude participant.

role.title: Agent role
role.description: Optional role label included on outbound messages.

peer.title: Default peer
peer.description: Optional actor used when a send does not name a recipient.

project.title: Holler project
project.description: Durable message partition used by this participant.

channel.title: Holler channel
channel.description: Default Holler channel within the project.

socket.title: Holler socket
socket.description: Optional hollerd Unix socket path; the standard user socket is used when empty.

name_mode.title: Actor naming mode
name_mode.description: Optional exact or allocate naming. Leave unset for legacy behavior.

binary.title: Holler executable
binary.description: Absolute holler executable recorded by setup for service-safe plugin startup.
